findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "web" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web_search, render_page, get_page_meta, extract_links, check_robots_txt, check_security_headers, verify_email, check_url_phishing, html_to_pdf, parse_url · Private data: render_page, get_page_meta, extract_links, parse_sitemap, check_robots_txt, check_security_headers, inspect_domain, rdap_lookup, verify_email, ip_lookup, check_url_phishing, html_to_text, extract_pdf, html_to_pdf, parse_url · Public sink: inspect_domain, rdap_lookup, verify_email, ip_lookup, check_url_phishing, html_to_text · Destructive: render_page, parse_sitemap, check_security_headers, html_to_text.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: web_search, render_page, get_page_meta, extract_links, check_robots_txt, check_security_headers, verify_email, check_url_phishing, html_to_pdf, parse_url · Private data: render_page, get_page_meta, extract_links, parse_sitemap, check_robots_txt, check_security_headers, inspect_domain, rdap_lookup, verify_email, ip_lookup, check_url_phishing, html_to_text, extract_pdf, html_to_pdf, parse_url · Public sink: inspect_domain, rdap_lookup, verify_email, ip_lookup, check_url_phishing, html_to_text · Destructive: render_page, parse_sitemap, check_security_headers, html_to_text

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
